name: Test Harness & Smoke Tests
description: Consumer-only test component comprising three files: (1) src/__tests__/setup.ts — Vitest setup importing @testing-library/jest-dom and centralizing vi.mock for convex/react hooks; (2) src/__tests__/tools-data.test.ts — pure data smoke tests validating the canonical 11-tool array structure, field presence, type constraints, and kindex-specific invariant; (3) src/__tests__/component-smoke.test.tsx — at least one @testing-library/react render test wrapping a presentational component in MemoryRouter. The contract is that `bunx vitest run` exits 0 with all tests passing. Vitest config lives in vite.config.ts test block with environment: 'jsdom', globals: true, setupFiles: ['./src/__tests__/setup.ts'], include: ['src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}']. DevDependencies: vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom — all installed via `bun add -d`.

functions.name: configure_vitest
functions.description: Defines and validates the vitest configuration block that must be added to the 'test' key of vite.config.ts. This is a pure configuration function — it produces the VitestConfigBlock struct. The resulting config sets environment to jsdom, globals to true, setupFiles to ['./src/__tests__/setup.ts'], and include to ['src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}'].

functions.name: initialize_setup_file
functions.description: Creates src/__tests__/setup.ts which: (1) imports '@testing-library/jest-dom' to extend expect matchers with DOM-specific assertions (toBeInTheDocument, toHaveTextContent, etc.); (2) calls vi.mock('convex/react') to provide safe defaults — useQuery returns undefined, useMutation returns vi.fn(). This file is executed once per test file invocation via vitest setupFiles.

functions.name: render_component_smoke_test
functions.description: Test case: renders at least one presentational component using @testing-library/react's render() within a <MemoryRouter> wrapper. Asserts the component does not throw during render and that the resulting container contains expected DOM content (verified via screen.getByText or container query). Convex hooks are mocked by setup.ts to prevent runtime errors.

side_effects: Spawns bunx vitest run as child process
Reads all test files and source files under src/

structured_side_effects.description: Vitest reads and parses all discovered test files
Vitest executes the setup file before each test file
Vitest reads vite config to extract test configuration block
Vitest resolves imports from test files into source modules (data layer, components)
Vitest outputs test results, pass/fail counts, and timing to console

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n = number of test cases

invariants: The test suite MUST pass with `bunx vitest run` exiting with code 0 and zero failures
The tools-data.test.ts file performs ONLY pure data assertions — no DOM, no rendering, no side effects
The component-smoke.test.tsx file renders at least one component wrapped in MemoryRouter
setup.ts MUST import '@testing-library/jest-dom' at module scope for extended matchers
setup.ts MUST mock 'convex/react' with useQuery returning undefined and useMutation returning vi.fn()
vite.config.ts test block MUST specify environment: 'jsdom', globals: true
All devDependencies (vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom) are installed via `bun add -d` — never npm or yarn
Test files reside exclusively under src/__tests__/ and match pattern src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}
No test file exceeds 300 lines per project operating procedures
The tests component exports nothing — it is a pure consumer of data_layer and ui_components

data_access.rationale: Tests read the canonical tools data array (PUBLIC tier — tool names, slugs, descriptions, versions, accent colors, video URLs are non-sensitive documentation metadata). Tests also import and render UI components to verify they produce correct DOM output. No data is written to any persistent store; all mutations are in-memory within the jsdom virtual DOM and are discarded after each test.

side_effects.rationale: Data smoke tests import the canonical tools array to validate cardinality (11 entries), ordered slug correctness, required field presence and format constraints, and the kindex videoUrl invariant
Component smoke test imports and renders at least one presentational component to verify it produces DOM content without throwing
Vitest reads configuration and test files from the local filesystem during test discovery and execution
